grok-4.7.pricingTier: xAI global standard Chat API token pricing
grok-4.7.pricingNotes: The exact Grok 4.7 pricing row lists $2.00/1M input, $0.50/1M cached input, and $6.00/1M output below 200,000 prompt tokens; at 200,000 or more prompt tokens all request tokens use $4.00/$1.00/$12.00 per million respectively. OCR estimates and observed usage use uncached rates. Reasoning tokens are billable output. US regional pricing adds 10%; this adapter uses the global endpoint. Priority, subscription-only Fast, cache discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes and credits are excluded. Per-page tokens and latency are uncalibrated planning heuristics.

limits.notes: https://docs.x.ai/developers/models and /developers/model-capabilities/images/understanding document PNG/JPG/JPEG and a 20 MiB image limit. AutoShow renders PDF pages to PNG and caps visible OCR output at 4,096 tokens per page; this is an application cap, not the model output limit. Grok 4.7 has no model text output limit. Required reasoning defaults to high; Batch is unsupported.
